name: integrated-hacking-toolkit
description: Penetration testing automation wrapper that is integrated with Nmap, Metasploit, Aircrack-ng suite, Social-Engineering Toolkit (SET), and more.

name: cvss-te
description: Improves vulnerability prioritization by enhancing CVSS scores with exploit intelligence. Combines data from CISA KEV, EPSS, Metasploit, and other sources to create actionable severity ratings that reflect real-world threat levels.

name: Metasploit-Framework-2025
description: Metasploit Framework for penetration testing and security research. Identify and exploit vulnerabilities in your network. 🔓🛠️

description: Conducted a cyber attack on a vulnerable Windows machine, performed post-exploitation, and analyzed forensic artifacts using Kali Linux, Metasploit, Nmap, Wireshark, Autopsy, Security Onion, and Volatility. Investigated network traffic, memory, and disk images to reconstruct the attack timeline.

name: HTB-OSCP-Prep
description: This guide details the steps for identifying and exploiting a vulnerable **Windows Legacy** machine, using enumeration, SMB vulnerability scanning, and exploitation with Metasploit.

name: SIT182-Essentials
description: A collection of essential scripts and tools for setting up a security-focused environment in Kali Linux, including automation for Docker, Metasploit, and LabSec installations.
